CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE materializer_assumption_check AS
WITH t1 AS (SELECT name FROM pragma_table_info('table_1')),
     t2 AS (SELECT name FROM pragma_table_info('table_2'))
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT 'table_1_has_uuid' AS item, COUNT(*)>0 AS ok FROM t1 WHERE lower(name)='uuid'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'table_1_has_frameversion' AS item, COUNT(*)>0 AS ok FROM t1 WHERE lower(name)='frameversion'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'table_2_has_uuid' AS item, COUNT(*)>0 AS ok FROM t2 WHERE lower(name)='uuid'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'table_2_has_format' AS item, COUNT(*)>0 AS ok FROM t2 WHERE lower(name)='format'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'table_2_has_status' AS item, COUNT(*)>0 AS ok FROM t2 WHERE lower(name)='status'
)
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "cards_with_legalities" AS SELECT l.uuid, c.frameversion, l.format AS legality_format, l.status AS legality_status FROM table_2 AS l JOIN table_1 AS c ON l.uuid = c.uuid

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH future_cards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT uuid
  FROM cards_with_legalities
  WHERE lower(coalesce(frameversion, '')) = 'future'
),
legalities_future AS (
  SELECT cwl.uuid, cwl.legality_format AS format, cwl.legality_status AS status
  FROM cards_with_legalities cwl
  JOIN future_cards fc ON cwl.uuid = fc.uuid
),
overall AS (
  SELECT 'overall_count' AS section,
         CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS format,
         CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS status,
         COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) AS value
  FROM future_cards
),
by_fmt AS (
  SELECT 'by_format_status' AS section,
         format,
         status,
         COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) AS value
  FROM legalities_future
  GROUP BY format, status
)
SELECT * FROM overall
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM by_fmt
ORDER BY section, format NULLS FIRST, status NULLS FIRST
